operator_io_quirks: Mixed quoting in DDL: storm uses double-quoted identifiers, region/affected_region use backticks; sqlite_master text must be replayed verbatim.
Table/column names are mixed case (Storm_ID, Region_id, Number_city_affected); column lookup must be case-insensitive, output keeps original spelling.
affected_region has composite PK (Region_id,Storm_ID) and two FKs to region and storm; both parents exist and are unique on their PKs.
Dates_active is TEXT storing human date ranges like 'May19–May25' with an en-dash (U+2013), not parseable by any of the 7 Date templates; declared TEXT so dispatches to String fuzzer.
All columns notnull=0 despite being PKs; sqlite PK on non-INTEGER columns is not implicitly NOT NULL, so NULL PK rows can be inserted and will be dropped by sample_fresh_primary_keys.
Max_speed values ~1000 (hurricane km/h) but declared INT -> Number fuzzer range [-10^0,10^0] default scale 0, so fresh draws are tiny ints, wildly off-scale.
Damage_millions_USD REAL with values like 0.039, 13.0; Number fuzzer scale 0 gives ints in [-1,1] plus +-1/+-2 perturbation, contradicting real storage.
Number_Deaths INT with 0 present; Number fuzzer int perturbation can produce negatives, which are implausible for deaths.
region.Region_code is 2-letter ISO text; String fuzzer will emit random a-zA-Z0-9() strings of length 0..20, not 2-letter codes.

Tiny tables (10, 13, 6 rows): choose_table_sizes level-0 = 1+30u and x4 per level easily exceeds original sizes; FK child draws from parent's final filtered values with replacement, so affected_region will have many duplicate (Region_id,Storm_ID) pairs before PK dedup.
No views/triggers/indexes beyond PKs; DDL replay is simple.
Dates_active en-dash and '–' separator: any downstream LIKE '%May%' style gold queries will match only if String fuzzer happens to emit 'May'.
operator_ts_expectations: storm.Storm_ID, region.Region_id: Number fuzzer, single-column PK -> max_l0=inf, fresh ints in [-1,1] perturbed; PK dedup keeps ~10-30 distinct small ints.

affected_region.Region_id/Storm_ID: FK columns, drawn from parent final values with replacement -> heavy duplication, then composite-PK dedup keeps first occurrence; final size <= min(|region|,|storm|) roughly.
affected_region.Number_city_affected: Number fuzzer scale 0 -> ints in [-1,1] perturbed, contradicting REAL storage and positive counts.
storm.Name: String fuzzer, random a-zA-Z 0-9() strings length 0..20 with 50% contaminate; original names 'One','Two' etc. only appear via 5 sampled originals.
storm.Dates_active: String fuzzer (TEXT), so 'May19–May25' style ranges never regenerated; fresh strings are random gibberish.
region.Region_code: String fuzzer, random 0..20-char strings, not 2-letter codes.
region.Region_name: String fuzzer, random strings, not country names.
storm.Max_speed: Number fuzzer scale 0 -> values near 0/+-1/+-2, not ~1000; gold queries filtering Max_speed > 900 will return empty on generated instances -> FN risk.
storm.Damage_millions_USD: Number fuzzer scale 0 -> ints, not reals like 0.039; gold queries with fractional thresholds or ORDER BY damage will behave differently.
storm.Number_Deaths: Number fuzzer can emit negatives; gold queries with Number_Deaths = 0 or > 0 may match spuriously (FP) or miss (FN).
affected_region.Number_city_affected: Number fuzzer ints, gold queries comparing to 10.0/15.0 etc. will mostly miss -> FN.

Composite PK dedup on affected_region after FK fill: since both FK columns draw from small parent sets, many rows collapse; final table may be much smaller than gold expects, driving FN on COUNT/aggregate queries.
